allocation.mechanism: Use the already-verified empty_full_write storage allocator for outputs whose kernels store every logical element; preserve dense transpose strides. No global deterministic flag changes.
allocation.safety: Enabled only inside candidate inference; poison all eligible output buffers on first whole-model warmup; retain exact coordinate and five-score hashes. Grad-enabled contexts fall back to torch allocation.
allocation.baseline: Rewrite module allocation alias to torch during FP32/TF32 baselines, eliminating the candidate helper branch from baseline timing.

mm.mechanism: Prepare RHS with the same shared RNE conversion once per eligible call; keep physical row/column-major layout. Reuse original mm_direct_fused, 64x128x32, four warps, stage=1, same Split-K and index-width rules; A conversion remains in MM.
mm.amortization: Original B conversion is repeated across M tiles. Preparation converts K*N values once, at the cost of one launch and a temporary dense RHS. Benefit must amortize this extra launch and allocation.
mm.resource_rule: M has at least 2048 tiles of 64 rows; dense RHS <=64MiB; ordinary TF32 inference. All other calls use original direct MM. No persistent RHS cache, no input/model/shape lookup table.
mm.layout: Column-major B is prepared as (N,K).T, preserving strides (1,K). Row-major B is prepared as (K,N). The flat preparation kernel reads/writes physical contiguous storage.
mm.dispatch: Small-M rejection precedes precision flags and stride checks. Whole-model screening exposed the cost of slow fallback dispatch.
mm.proof: Original real activation tensors and their SHA256 are checked on PPU; before/after TF32 MM outputs match bitwise. Compilation excluded, preparation/allocation included in warmed public-MM device timings.

scope.whole_model: cycle=1, diffusion step=1, sample=1; full real audited inputs G01/G02, nine checkpoints; original hardware servers, physical GPU7.
scope.precision: No change in numerical TF32 policy. Formal native H100 TF32 accuracy gate remains unchanged if coordinate hashes remain identical.
